images.caption: Figure 1:Overview of the proposed method:Inspired by how humans approach a problem, the model first tries to solve each problem without access to hints. When it succeeds, the correct response is directly reinforced. When it fails, progressively stronger rationales are introduced as temporary scaffolds to guide the model toward a correct solution.
